Course Title: Data Structures
Date: 05/17/2024
Course Number: COP 3530
Number of Credits: 3
Subject Area: Programming

Catalog Description: Basic concepts of data organization, running time of a program, abstract types, data structures including linked lists, n-ary trees, sets and graphs, internal sorting. This course will have additional fees.

Textbook: Data Structures & Problem Solving in Java by Mark Weiss
References:
Prerequisites Courses: COP 3337 and (MAD 2104 or COT 3100)
Co-requisites Courses: None
